_README: Bundle-size budgets enforced by scripts/size-check.ts. Each entry is a path to a built artifact relative to the repo root plus a `gzBudget` in bytes (gzip default level). Budgets are set with ~25-50% headroom over the current measurements as of 2026-05-30 so small additions don't fail CI, but a serious regression does. Raise a budget only when an intentional new feature lands; otherwise treat a bust as a bug.
